description: Landes : Point de prélèvement d'eau au milieu naturel effectué pour l'irrigation is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by landes.equipement-agriculture.gouv.fr. Point of abstraction of water from the natural environment carried out for irrigation - Positioning of water sampling points in the natural environment carried out for irrigation. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Landes: Point of abstraction of water from the natural environment carried out for irrigation" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include points, milieux naturels, irrigations, inspire, prélèvements, eau. The listing shows 2011-09-14 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
